>
[Athamaru Weapon Familiarity](/Feats.aspx?ID=5274) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Athamaru" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=741" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 18

</column>

---

You wield weapons designed to work underwater with ease. You have familiarity with weapons with the [athamaru](/Traits.aspx?ID=741) trait and with [crossbows](/Weapons.aspx?ID=425), [heavy crossbows](/Weapons.aspx?ID=428), [longspears](/Weapons.aspx?ID=361), [spears](/Weapons.aspx?ID=365), and [tridents](/Weapons.aspx?ID=401)—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons.

 At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its [critical specialization effect](/Rules.aspx?ID=235).
name: Athamaru Weapon Familiarity
